title: Administrator - Data Entry Project
salary_text: £12.71 - £13 per hour (Immediate start and great training)
description:
Are you available to start a temporary data entry project ASAP?

We're looking for someone to support a busy data cleansing and administration project for a business based in Telford, specifically within the TF1 area, as they prepare for the implementation of a brand-new HR system in February.

There is a huge volume of employee data and physical documentation that needs to be reviewed, cleansed, updated and organised ahead of the changeover. You'll be supporting the team with a variety of data entry and general administration tasks, including scanning documents, logging information, organising paperwork, securely destroying documents where required and updating employee records.

This would be a fantastic opportunity for a graduate or school leaver looking to gain some valuable office administration experience, or someone who enjoys organised, process-driven work and is happy getting stuck into a busy data entry project.

The role is on a temporary basis, paying 13.00 per hour + holiday accrual, with weekly pay. The position will start ASAP and is expected to be ongoing, with the potential for around five months of work and possibly the opportunity to support the business further during the transition to its new HR system.

The hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm, with a one-hour lunch break. Due to the nature of the project and the volume of physical paperwork involved, this will be a fully office-based position in Telford.

Please note that due to the type of project this is, the successful candidate will be required to sign an NDA before commencing any work.

What does the day-to-day look like?

This is a very admin-heavy, data entry-focused project, supporting the business in getting its employee records and documentation ready for a major HR system change.

You'll be scanning and logging documents, organising physical records, updating employee information, cleansing existing data and ensuring everything is accurate, up to date and ready for the transition. You'll need to be comfortable carrying out repetitive tasks and working through a high volume of information, with accuracy and attention to detail being key.

What do we need from you?
- Good attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with data and documentation.
- Basic computer skills and a willingness to learn new systems and processes.
- A proactive attitude and the ability to get stuck into a busy, hands-on administration project.
- Someone who is comfortable with repetitive data entry and document management tasks.
- The ability to start ASAP and commit to an ongoing temporary assignment.
- The ability to commute easily to the Telford TF1 area, as the role is fully office-based.

Previous office administration experience would be beneficial, but it's certainly not essential. We'd be very happy to hear from graduates, school leavers or anyone looking to gain valuable experience in an office environment.

What next?

If you're available to start ASAP and think this could be a good fit, apply for the role or get in touch with Bobby to find out more. We're keen to speak with candidates as soon as possible, with a view to getting someone started ASAP.

Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment.

title: Technical Records Administrator - MFTS
company: Red Sky Personnel Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Technical Records Administrator MFTS

Location: Shawbury

About the Opportunity

We are recruiting on behalf of our client, a leading organisation within the helicopter and aviation industry, for a Technical Records Administrator to join their team based at Oxford Airport.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented and organised individual to join a specialist aviation environment, supporting the management, review and maintenance of essential technical records.

The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring technical documentation is accurate, up to date and compliant with relevant company procedures and aviation regulations. You will work closely with the Technical Records Supervisor and wider engineering and continuing airworthiness teams, helping maintain accurate records that support aircraft safety and airworthiness.

We are looking for someone methodical, proactive and confident working with digital systems, who can manage competing priorities and deliver work to agreed deadlines.

The Role

As a Technical Records Administrator, you will be responsible for the day-to-day review, processing and administration of aircraft maintenance records, ensuring that all relevant information is accurately recorded within the company's record management system.

You will support the wider technical and airworthiness teams by maintaining documentation, updating aircraft and component logbooks, preparing records for audits and ensuring records are properly archived.

Key Responsibilities
- Review and process technical records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company procedures and applicable aviation regulations.
- Update the record management system with regulatory, optional and non-routine maintenance task completion details.
- Maintain and update aircraft and component logbooks.
- Copy, organise and archive aircraft maintenance records in accordance with established procedures.
- Return component log cards to the relevant materials management team for core returns.
- Assist with the preparation of technical documentation for regulatory audits.
- Generate monthly flying-hour reports and maintain accurate supporting records.
- Identify discrepancies, missing information or potential compliance issues and take appropriate action.
- Provide administrative and technical records support across the wider continuing airworthiness management team.
- Work closely with colleagues and management to ensure records are maintained accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Undertake additional duties as required by the department's management team.

Essential Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
- A methodical approach to work and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to work independently, use initiative and contribute effectively as part of a team.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise tasks against deadlines.
- A proactive approach to identifying errors, discrepancies and potential issues before they affect operations.
- Good computer literacy, including confidence using Google Docs and digital record management systems.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to communicate professionally with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels.
- A reliable, flexible and professional approach to work.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following would be advantageous:
- Previous experience in an aviation, engineering or technical records environment.
- Knowledge of Continuing Airworthiness Management Organisation (CAMO) procedures.
- Familiarity with UK Civil Aviation Authority regulations, particularly Part-CAMO and Part-145.
- Experience using aviation maintenance or continuing airworthiness management software.
- Knowledge of aircraft maintenance documentation, component records and technical logbooks.
- An understanding of aviation human factors and airworthiness compliance.

Qualifications

Essential:
- A minimum of five GCSEs at Grade C or above, or equivalent recognised qualifications such as NVQs or BTECs.

Desirable:
- An aviation-related degree or equivalent qualification.
- Recognised Part-CAMO or Part-145 training.
- Aviation human factors training.

Additional Requirements
- Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
- The successful candidate must be able to meet the requirements of Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks and obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
- Applicants must satisfy any applicable export compliance requirements.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Consula is recruiting on behalf of a well-established Shropshire employer looking to appoint a motivated and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join their dedicated commercial finance team. Our client has cultivated an enviable regional reputation for operational excellence, integrity, and consistent commercial growth, and they pride themselves on maintaining a professional, forward-thinking workplace where teamwork and accountability underpin everything they do. As they continue to expand their local and regional operations, maintaining financial robustness remains vital to their continued success.

The Accounts Assistant plays an indispensable role within our client's core infrastructure, ensuring that every financial transaction is recorded with accuracy, compliance, and rigour. Without the diligent support of their transactional team, strategic decision-making and seamless day-to-day commercial operations simply would not be possible. Working closely with the wider department, you will ensure supplier relationships remain strong, income flow stays healthy, and month-end routines run effortlessly.

Set in the heart of Shropshire, our client's office provides a truly attractive working environment that seamlessly combines the charm of a bustling historic market town with modern amenities and scenic countryside right on the doorstep. With excellent road and rail connectivity across the county and the wider West Midlands, it is a fantastic location to build a long-term, balanced career.

Location: Shropshire

Salary: £28,000 - £31,000 per year

Employment: Permanent

The Role

As an Accounts Assistant, you will play a central part in the day-to-day running of our client's busy finance function, ensuring transactions are accurately recorded and operations run smoothly.
- Managing end-to-end purchase ledger processing, from matching purchase orders and invoices to preparing weekly supplier payment runs.
- Handling sales ledger administration, including raising accurate customer invoices, issuing statements, and actively credit controlling outstanding balances.
- Performing regular bank reconciliations across multi-currency and sterling accounts to maintain up-to-date cash flow records.
- Reconciling key supplier statements and promptly resolving complex ledger discrepancies or disputed charges.
- Assisting the Finance Manager with month-end routines, including posting journals, accruals, prepayments, and nominal ledger reconciliations.
- Processing and auditing employee expense claims and corporate credit card expenditure in line with internal financial policies.
- Acting as the primary point of contact for internal colleagues and external vendors regarding accounts queries via telephone and email.
- Maintaining accurate digital financial archives and supporting internal and external year-end audit preparations.
- Generating regular aged debtor and creditor reports to highlight potential risks and cash flow bottlenecks to management.

About You
- Essential: Proven hands-on experience within a fast-paced accounts or transactional finance environment.
- Essential: Strong fundamental knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping, purchase ledger, sales ledger, and credit control procedures.
- Essential: Competent user of modern accounting software packages such as Sage, Xero, QuickBooks, or equivalent ERP systems.
- Essential: Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including the confident use of VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, and formula-driven spreadsheets.
- Essential: High degree of numerical precision, exceptional attention to detail, and a meticulous approach to data entry.
- Essential: Excellent communication skills with the confidence to deal tactfully with suppliers, clients, and departmental managers.
- Desirable: Actively studying towards or holding an AAT qualification, or possessing an equivalent professional finance qualification.
- Desirable: Proactive mindset with a genuine willingness to review existing administrative processes and recommend practical improvements.

A Typical Day

You will start your morning reviewing incoming bank feeds, matching receipts, and updating cash sheets before settling down to process supplier invoices awaiting approval. Mid-morning might involve a quick touchpoint with the Finance Manager to run through urgent payment schedules, followed by focused contact with customers to reconcile accounts and chase overdue debts. In the afternoon, you could find yourself resolving a supplier pricing query with the operations team, posting routine month-end adjustment journals, and compiling an aged debtors summary before wrapping up your day with clean ledgers and completed reconciliations.

What You Can Expect
- A secure, permanent role within a progressive and stable Shropshire organisation that values team contribution.
- 28 days annual leave including bank holidays.
- A supportive management team that genuinely invests in your professional development and AAT study ambitions.
- Modern, comfortable offices with free on-site parking and excellent local transport links.
- Regular team social events and a friendly, down-to-earth working culture.
- A varied workload where no two days are the same, with real scope to shape and improve processes.
- The chance to build a long-term career with an employer that promotes from within wherever possible.

If you are an organised, numerate accounts professional looking for your next challenge in Shropshire, we would love to hear from you. Apply through Consula today and Doug, our AI talent partner, will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.

title: Logistics Co-Ordinator
description:
K.A.G. Recruitment is delighted to be working exclusively with our client, one of Europe's leading privately owned food processors, to recruit a Logistics Co-Ordinator for their operation in Oswestry.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced logistics professional to play a key role in coordinating international exports, ensuring the efficient movement of goods, accurate documentation and successful delivery to customers.

Role: Logistics Co-Ordinator
Location: Oswestry, Shropshire
Salary: £35,000-£37,000 DOE
Hours: Monday-Friday, 40 hours per week (office-based flexibility on start/finish times due to business needs)

The Role
You will be responsible for coordinating transport, export administration and the movement of chilled goods through a third-party logistics provider, ensuring shipments are compliant, accurately documented and delivered on time.

Key Responsibilities:
- Consolidate site orders and commercial load manifests into timely load plans.
- Book approved carriers and coordinate goods receipt, checking, loading, despatch and delivery.
- Check physical goods against pre-advice, order details and supporting documentation.
- Ensure trailers are correctly temperature-set, securely loaded and sealed in line with procedures.
- Prepare and check export and import documentation, including health certificates, veterinary inspections and customs requirements.
- Monitor shipments through customs and sanitary inspections, resolving issues that could delay delivery.
- Investigate and record non-conformances, coordinating corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.
- Produce operational reports, check invoices and allocate or recharge transport costs to the appropriate sites.

Skills & Experience
You will be an organised and proactive individual with experience in FMCG transport or logistics administration, ideally within an international operation. You will have strong Excel skills, practical knowledge of export/import documentation and controls.

You'll also bring excellent attention to detail, resilience and strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to take ownership of issues and see them through to resolution.

Interested?
If you have the logistics experience and attention to detail needed to keep a busy export operation running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this opportunity through K.A.G. Recruitment.

description: Receptionist and Administrator Vacancy Full Time Receptionist Working days/hours - Monday to Friday, hours between 8:00 am and 6:30 pm. An exciting opportunity to join our friendly and welcoming Reception team, working across two sites, in our five-doctor GP partnership, based in rural Shropshire, just south of Shrewsbury. Main duties of the job To provide a first point of contact for patients at the reception desk, and on the telephones, and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. To book and manage appointments and provide reception cover across both of our practice sites. JOB DESCRIPTION RECEPTIONIST Responsible To: Practice Manager PURPOSE OF POST: To provide a point of contact for patients and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. To book appointments and provide reception cover across both of our practice sites. Major Duties and Responsibilities of the Post Duties: Ensure efficiency of the EMIS computerized appointment system and monitor the flow of patients into consulting rooms. Ensure that patients without appointments but who need to see a doctor urgently are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Respond to all requests for assistance from patients and other visitors EMIS Appointment System: Ensure accurate and timely entries are made onto the patient administration system, EMIS. Book appointments and recalls ensuring sufficient information is recorded to retrieve medical records Monitor effectiveness of the system and report any problems or variations required Management of Medical Records: Retrieve and re file records if required, ensuring that strict alphabetical order is adhered to Operation of Telephone System: Receive and make calls as required. Divert calls and take accurate messages as required Ensure that the system is operational at the beginning of each day and switch to night service at the end of each day Start and End of Day Procedures: Open up premises at the start of day, making tea & coffee and make all necessary preparations to receive patients Download Shropdoc reports, print off and pass to duty GP Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post Special Requirements of the Post: An understanding, acceptance and adherence to the need for strict confidentiality as failure to do so will result in dismissal An ability to use own judgment, resourcefulness, common sense to respond to patients non clinical inquiries and requests Excellent communication skills Accuracy in transcribing information Ability to work without supervision and determine own workload priorities Keyboard skills and computer literacy skills desirable Ability to work well within a team and under pressure Ability to be flexible within the working week if needed, and to be prepared to work some evenings and weekends as and when required
